title: Indian Patents and Designs Extension of Time Amendment Act 1948

sections.shortTitle: Indian Patents and Designs Extension of Time Amendment Act 1948
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

Act No
Act No. XXV of 1948
Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time)
Amendment Act, 1948.
An Act further to amend the Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of
Time) Act, 1942
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time)
Act, 1912, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows: -
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This
Act may be called the Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Amendment
Act, 1948.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Indian Patents and Designs Extension of Time Amendment Act 1948
sections.description:
Amendment of section 1, Act X of 1942

Act No
Act No. XXV of 1948
Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time)
Amendment Act, 1948.
An Act further to amend the Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of
Time) Act, 1942
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time)
Act, 1912, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows: -
2. Amendment of section 1, Act X of 1942.-For
sub-section (3) of section 1 of the Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of
Time) Act, 1942 (hereinafter referred to as the " said Act "), the
following sub-section shall be substituted, and shall be deemed always to have
been substituted, namely
(3) It shall be in force upto
the thirty-first day of December, 1949."

clauses (a) and (b) of sub-section 1 of section 2 of the said Act, after the
words " present hostilities " the words " or the setting up of
the two 'separate Dominions of India and Pakistan"" shall be
inserted, and shall be deemed to have been inserted, as from the fifteenth day
of August, 1947.
